correctness.rationale: The intersection counts for all ordered AP/path-edge pairs are exact; hypergeometric inclusion yields the mixed moment; the quadratic F(k) vanishes at n, and its two affine endpoint values are manifestly strictly positive by Euclidean-division identities. The n=ell+1 case is handled independently and k<ell or k=n yield zero. Exact rational independent enumeration verified 806 assertions through n=13, as corroboration, not all-size proof.

originality.rationale: Direct comparisons with original and later AP-count full texts identify differences in random sampling law, second coordinate of the joint law, and finite all-parameter sign. Generic hypergraph overlap accounting does not by itself prove the AP-specific positive sign; accessible mathematical records did not produce an implication-dominating prior theorem. Historical implicit coverage remains an explicit risk.
residual_risks: A historical exact hypergraph-moment result not found or not fully accessible might imply the same inequality after specializing to path edges and AP hyperedges.
An alternative combinatorial formulation might hide the same all-length positivity under another name; searches and full-text theorem comparison reduce but do not eliminate this possibility.

value.rationale: The arithmetic-progression count and occupied-run count are natural additive-pattern and clustering statistics on the fixed-cardinality hypergeometric null. Their covariance sign is not a generic positive-dependence consequence (individual site indicators are negatively dependent, and arbitrary triple containment can have opposite sign). The result proves the full all-length/all-density sign with a transparent exact expression, sharp degenerate boundaries and an explicit counterexample to stronger regression claims; no future theorem is assumed.
